articleTitle: PBFT consensus algorithm based on reward and punishment mechanism
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: The Practical Byzantine Fault Tolerant (PBFT) algorithm is a common consensus algorithm for coalition chain, but it has some problems such as low efficiency, poor scalability and high communication complexity. To solve these problems, this paper proposes a PBFT consensus algorithm based on reward and punishment mechanism (RP-PBFT). Based on the PBFT algorithm, the algorithm rewards and penalises the performance of each node in the consensus process, and divides the nodes into three categories according to their reputation value. The two categories of nodes with high reputation value can participate in the consensus, reduce the scale of nodes participating in the consensus, improve the security and simplify the three-stage consensus to improve the efficiency. The experimental results show that the communication complexity of RP-PBFT algorithm is significantly reduced, the throughput is increased, the delay is reduced, and the system efficiency is improved.

articleTitle: Time-frequency Analysis of Non-stationary Signal Based on Sliding Mode Singular Spectrum Analysis and Wigner-ville Distribution
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: In order to obtain better performance of time-frequency representation(TFR) in non-stationary signal processing using Wigner-Ville distribution(WVD), an adaptive time-frequency analysis method based on combination of sliding mode singular spectrum analysis(SM-SSA) and Wigner-Ville distribution(SM-SSA-WVD) was proposed. Through mode decomposition of original signal by SM-SSA and linear superposition of TFRs for each mode by WVD, the cross terms are effectively suppressed, which obtaining higher adaptive ability and energy concentration of WVD results comparing to the traditional WVD methods. The proposed cross-term free method is applied to analyze several kinds of simulated clean and noisy multi-component modulated signals. The TFRs of the proposed method work better in restraining the cross terms of WVD than some other adaptive decomposition methods, thus obtaining higher time-frequency resolution and noise robustness.

articleTitle: Research on the Teaching Reform of Integrating Mathem-atical Modeling into Probability Theory and Mathematical Statistics
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Mathematical modeling is an important practical activity that solves practical problems by using all kinds of mathematical knowledge comprehensively. Various kinds of mathematical modeling contests full of vitality and broad space for development not only provide students with the ability to demonstrate applied mathematics, but also put forward clearer demands for mathematics teaching in colleges and universities. It is a serious problem for mathematics teachers to integrate the idea of mathematical modeling into the daily teaching of probability theory and mathematical statistics so that students can learn the course better.

articleTitle: The Analysis of Influencing Factors of Wisdom Classroom Teaching Based on Random Forest
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: In the “Internet +” era, smart education is the hot spot in the constr, In the era of “Internet +”, smart classroom is a hot spot in the construction and development of education and teaching. This paper takes the computer major course scores in the online smart platform of a university in Chongqing as an example, and then uses the random forest model to reduce the dimension of influencing factors, and then uses Spearman correlation analysis to analyze the correlation of variables after dimensionality reduction. Find the important influencing factors and the interaction between the important influencing factors. This paper discusses the influence degree of each dimension in the smart classroom environment on the final examination score, and then provides the selection basis for the discussion of the teaching design and mode of smart classroom.

articleTitle: Design and Application of Online Training System for Illustration Design Based on Streaming Media Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Under the ecological environment of JAVAWeb, this paper uses streaming media technology, RTMP+HLS protocol, audio and video tool FFmpeg to realize live teaching, and JAVA+Tomcat+MySQL+Spring technology stack to realize online learning, and constructs an online training system for illustration design, which can effectively solve the problems of insufficient illustration design class hours, tight or limited teaching resources, and loss of students’ learning subject status. The system has set up two login platforms for students and teachers, which not only simplifies the operation, but also strengthens the communication and contact between teachers and students. The system is not only an illustration design live broadcast platform, but also an open illustration resource sharing platform and illustration learning platform. It provides good learning and practice opportunities for illustration design students in colleges and universities, helps them to better master illustration knowledge, improve illustration skills and accept the edification of illustration art.

articleTitle: Research on Personalized Recommendation Technology for Learning Resources Combining Knowledge Graph and Interest Diffusion Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Under the background of Internet technology maturing gradually, the acquisition of learning resources has become increasingly convenient. However, the accompanying “Information Explosion” makes it easy for learners to get lost in the ocean of learning materials and also make it difficult to find the resources they really need. In the face of this reality, it is urgent to explore the implementation and optimization of personalized recommendation technology. In order to make the personalized recommendation technology play a greater role in the field of education, this paper studies a learning resource recommendation algorithm which combines knowledge graph and interest diffusion mechanism, and makes a structure analysis of the recommendation system. Because the proposed technology considers the domain features of the recommended object, it reflects the combination of technology and education, and is of certain reference significance for further research on personalized recommendation of learning resources and personalized learning.

articleTitle: The Algorithm of Student Grade Evaluation Based on Clustering
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Aiming at the current assessment methods of college courses, an algorithm of student grade evaluation based on clustering is proposed. Using course performance data from multiple platforms, after preprocessing and integration, K-means algorithm is used to classify the results, and then Mahalanobis distance is used to achieve the grade evaluation of the results. The experimental results show that the proposed algorithm has a good effect, the algorithm has a guiding significance for the students in the edge of classification, and has a good application value.

articleTitle: Sports analysis in the era of big data: a perception utilizing SAP HANA Database
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Almost every aspect of our lives has been deeply influenced by data explosion, with massive datasets that can be used for analysis. Nowadays, big data has become one of the hot issues in the IT field. The most significant thing is how to process and analyze data. Big data can be applied to various fields, such as enterprise, banking, education, security, etc, to make wise decisions and improve efficiency. The sports industry, especially athlete, is closely connected with large numbers of data and with-out big data, it could not be meaningfully handled, for example the pseudocode for analyzing athlete’s recovery %. This article will majorly explore how athletes and sports industry influenced by big data, combined with SAP HANA Database.

articleTitle: Social Recommendation Algorithm Based on Learning Interests and Styles for Online Blended Learning Platform
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Information overload is a common problem in the construction of online platforms for blended learning, and personalized recommendation is a solution to this challenge. However, the traditional collaborative filtering recommendation algorithm is not fully applicable to online blended learning platforms characterized by sparse rating data and rich text and social information. In this paper, a new model of user learning interest similarity measurement was constructed using the author-topic model based on user-generated text and behavior information. Comprehensive user trust relationships were constructed and comprehensive trust was calculated based on user interaction behavior information by taking trust and distrust factors into full account. User learning styles were automatically identified by analyzing users’ multidimensional learning behavior patterns. Finally, a social recommendation algorithm integrating interest similarity, comprehensive trust, and learning styles was proposed. In addition, an experimental analysis was conducted using the actual data set of the online blended learning platform China University MOOC. The results indicated that the recommended method in this paper can better recommend learning resources of interest to users and effectively improve the recommendation accuracy, thus improving users’ learning effect.

articleTitle: Research on State Monitoring of Ship Power System Based on Multi-channel Data Acquisition System
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: The multi-channel high real-time data acquisition and processing system is a key component of the normal and reliable operation of the modern intelligent ship electric power system, which is crucial to the real-time monitoring of the power quality of the electric power system and the operation status information of the electric power system equipment. By analyzing the architecture of multi-channel data acquisition system and the principle of data acquisition and data processing, this paper designs a multi-channel data acquisition and processing system, and builds a physical system test platform. The actual operation proves that this system can meet the needs of power system data acquisition in high real-time and high synchronization.

articleTitle: A Cognitive Study on Amdo Tibetan College Students’ English Auditory Word Recognition Based on High Speed Data Acquisition
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Word recognition has been one of the focuses of cognitive linguistic research in recent years. The Hi-speed eye-tracking instrument produced by SMI Company in Germany was used to do research on Amdo Tibetan college students’ English word recognition by auditory priming. The experimental results showed that “sound” was activated first, then “form”, and finally “meaning”. Based on this, Phonetic Principal and Form Auxiliary Route was constructed. The results illustrate that when the Amdo Tibetan college students process auditory English vocabulary, they not only pay attention to “sound” input also to the role of “form”. Therefore, the English teachers need to make full use of the privilege of trilinguals’ auditory route, strengthen the input of “sound”, and meanwhile pay attention to the auxiliary function of “form” to improve trilingual college students’ efficiency of word recognition.

articleTitle: A Study on the Evaluation of Virtual Simulation Teaching Effectiveness in Communication Technology Major Integrating Curriculum Civics
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: With the development of computer communication technology in the direction of virtualization, in the teaching of Communication Technology Major, it is necessary to analyze the actual effect of virtual reality technology in practical training teaching to ensure that students can grasp communication professional skills more easily while being able to experience the more convenience brought by the use of virtual reality technology for learning and career cognition. In this paper, combined with the assessment system of virtual simulation of communication principle course, the course Civic elements are incorporated into the assessment system, the virtual simulation teaching effect assessment model based on extended cloud is adopted, the teaching effect assessment index system is constructed, the evaluated elements and the standard cloud model are determined, the correlation degree is calculated according to the characteristics of precise and fuzzy indexes, the correlation degree matrix of assessment is formed, and the index weights are determined through hierarchical analysis. Thus, the virtual simulation teaching effect assessment grade is obtained. Finally, the reliability and rationality of the assessment method are verified by actual teaching cases.

articleTitle: Ability Similarity Measure of MOOC Learners Based on Video Learning Data
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Similarity measure of MOOC learners is a hot topic in the current research of educational data mining, and it is also the basis of learners clustering and grouping. In the online education environment based on MOOC, learning MOOC videos is one of the most basic behaviors of learners. The degree and ability of learners to master the videos’ content can be implicitly obtained through their video learning behavior, thus providing a basis for the measure of learners’ ability similarity. Most existing researches on the similarity of learners focus on the similarity of learners’ interests or behavior patterns, and the similarity measure of ability is ignored. Meanwhile, most existing works only use video related data as a dimension of learners’ similarity measure, and there are still shortcomings in judging the ability similarity of learners. This paper proposes an approach to measure learners’ ability similarity based on MOOC video learning data. Based on the videos and their learning times of learners, a bipartite graph model is constructed, and the ability similarity between all learners is measured iteratively through SimRank++ algorithm. The experiments based on the real data set show that the proposed approach has better accuracy than the cosine similarity that is widely used in related works, and the NDCG value is increased by 34% on average.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Online Edit and Storage System for College High-Quality Video Resource Based on 4K
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: In recent years, the development of information technology and computer technology has profoundly changed society at an unprecedented rate. Video technology has also experienced the evolution from analog to standard digital definition and Ultra High-Definition(4K/8K). The application of 4K Ultra High-Definition technology in High-Quality teaching courses will be the tendency in the future, and major colleges and universities are consistently stepping up the pace of building a 4K High-Quality educational resource environment. This paper discusses the development of 4K Ultra High-Definition digital technology. It focuses on designing and constructing an online editing and storage system for 4K High-Quality video teaching resources in colleges and universities. This system is High-bandwidth real-time sharing, high-speed online editing, and high-security storage management, which have promoted the construction of High-Quality video teaching and learning resources and improved informatization teaching.

articleTitle: Application of Virtual Simulation Experimental Teaching Platform of Vehicle-infrastructure Collaboration Perception in Postgraduate Education
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: In order to meet the teaching needs of the vehicle-infrastructure collaboration perception experiment course, this paper presents a virtual simulation experiment teaching platform. It is easy to operate, which takes Unity3d as the main development platform and contains two modules. Students can simulate the actual driving process through the platform to obtain driving data to analyze driver behavior. It effectively solved the problems of limited teaching funds and student safety management during the COVID-19. The platform can meet the diverse learning needs of students, and enrich the teaching mode and assessment method of the course. Finally, through the design of driving style analysis experiment and satisfaction survey, the usability of the experimental teaching platform in practical teaching has been verified.

articleTitle: Design and Practice of University Smart Campus Integration Platform under the Background of Big Data
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: The construction of intelligent campus in colleges and universities can provide more humanized services to teachers and students through rational distribution of data resources, which can better promote the progress of education. Therefore, this paper studies the design and practice of the integrated platform of smart campus in colleges and universities under the background of big data. In this paper, hadoop distributed storage and spark computing components are used, and javaweb technology is used to develop this platform. In terms of system performance, the average data response time is 53 m s, the bit error rate can reach below 0.3%, the average database size is 122.7 T B, and the number of queries can reach more than 10 000 times. This paper makes an in-depth study on the process of data sharing and exchange, and on this basis, puts forward a concrete construction scheme for the integration of intelligent campus in colleges and universities, and sums up the intelligent application and service mode of campus data. The experiment shows that this research is conducive to improving the accuracy of campus data governance, at the same time, improving the collaboration of campus management services, and meeting the long-term development needs of intelligent campus.

articleTitle: Research on The Classification and Application of Social Emotional Information in Water-saving Education Based on Facial Recognition Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Water scarcity is a worldwide problem that is closely aligned with the United Nations’ Sustainable Development Goals. Education is considered to be an effective means to promote people’s participation in water conservation. So far, emotional and moral education in water-saving education is important and emotions have been used to promote various pro-environmental behaviors, but researchers have rarely discussed how emotions affect water-saving behavior from the social level in water-saving education. This research is trying to use facial recognition technology to assist psychology to categories individual’s social emotions and analyze individual’s psychological characteristics in front of certain water-saving situations in terms of emotion. This research uses facial recognition technology, to recognize mood swings automatically caused by when different pictures were presented. It proves that pictures of specific scenes can cause different social emotions between individuals based on different experiments. Eventually, a set of positive and negative social-emotional pictures were selected. It not only provides a new measurement method for future research on social emotions, but also provides a new understanding of classroom teaching and outdoor teaching in water-saving education, and also provides theoretical support for the compilation of water-saving education textbooks.

articleTitle: A Joint Simulation Framework based on OPNET External System Module for Tactical Data Links
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: A novel joint simulation framework based on OPNET External System Module (ESM) for tactical data links is proposed. It uses the extension interface to organically combine the data link node model of the OPNET simulation platform with ESM based on C/C++, and drives the time rolling and event execution of the OPNET simulation platform and ESM through the execution controller. Then, the SPMA protocol of TTNT waveform is taken as an example to illustrate the design and implementation of the key links in the joint simulation framework, such as expansion interface, node model, ESM, etc. Finally, a typical network scene are set to comprehensively evaluate the rate control of SPMA and other key functional indicators, which verifies the effectiveness of the proposed joint simulation framework.

articleTitle: The Role of Social Psychology in Human-computer Interaction in Teaching Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Under the trend of digitalization and informatization of teaching systems, the design and application of human-computer interaction technology reflects the psychology of human as a social being. The design of the human-computer interaction process in the informatization and digital teaching system collects information and data by establishing usage feedback, enhances the user experience in the human-computer interaction process through computer vision technology, visualizes the information with Focus+Context technology, and deeply integrates the user with the digital teaching system by establishing a model of the user’s demand for the teaching system. In addition, according to the user’s psychology when maintaining attention to the system, the network feature model of CSP+CBAM is constructed by using Yolov4-Tiny network, which integrates spatial attention and channel attention into the network of CBAM.

articleTitle: Construction of College Sculpture Course Online Training System Based on Virtual Reality Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: With the rapid development of science and technology, the digital society has gradually formed, which makes the sculpture teaching methods in colleges and universities also have a digital evolution. Compared with traditional sculpture teaching, digital sculpture teaching in colleges and universities based on virtual reality technology can show the artistic beauty of sculpture course more conveniently and comprehensively. In order to explore the digital teaching mode of university sculpture course, this paper studies the online training system of university sculpture course based on virtual reality technology. In this system, a sculpture model is established by 3dsmax, and various business functions of the application system are developed by using the script compiler and C# language in unity3D rendering scene. The relational database uses SQL Sever to build the database server, and the web server uses Apache tomcat. The video files of this system are stored on a separate FMS server for convenient and quick access. The practice shows that the development of this application system can further develop and improve the digital teaching methods of sculpture courses in colleges and universities.

articleTitle: Development and Application of Assessment Tools Based on Cognitive Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: As information technology in education penetrates the teaching process, personalized teaching has become a research hotspot in the field of education. The deep integration of cognitive diagnosis and education provides an effective measurement and assessment method for personalized teaching. Based on the theory of cognitive diagnosis and test data, this paper makes a different analysis of students’ cognitive status. The study found that the cognitive diagnosis identified each student’s attribute mastery pattern, and students who had the same score did not mean they had the same mastery pattern. This provides teachers with diversified and personalized feedback information for specific teaching.

articleTitle: Design and Development of KPI Performance Management System in Colleges and Universities under BS Framework
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: At present, there are still a series of problems to be solved urgently in the performance management of colleges and universities, such as weak process of performance appraisal, imperfect performance management system and lack of pertinence of performance management. In this paper, the author uses B/S architecture as the development framework of performance management system, Windows 10.0 as the operating system, C# as the programming language, and ASP.NET as the development platform. ASP.NET works by HTTP protocol, and uses HTTP commands to set up the two-way communication between browser and server to ensure the system running. Visual Studio 2019 is selected as the bottom development tool, SQL server database is selected to store system data, and aspx function page is set under the function module, so as to improve the detailed functions of each module of KPI performance management system in colleges and universities. In the aspect of web server, the system chooses IIS version 10.0 to improve the operation ability of the server.

articleTitle: Research on the mechanism of critical thinking in online asynchronous discussion
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: With the development of the Internet and the increasing frequency of online learning, online discussion is of great significance to promote the development of critical thinking. Based on the content analysis method, this paper extracts and analyzes the feature elements of the online asynchronous discussion forum data, finds out the common feature elements of eliciting and maintaining critical thinking, and puts forward some strategies to promote the critical online asynchronous discussion. This paper provides critical elements for the design of online learning activities so as to improve the quality of teachers’ online course design. Enable learners to find their way through online asynchronous discussion, thus improving learning efficiency.

articleTitle: Development of VisualC++, a multimedia speech teaching system
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: The informationization has brought the non-negligible impact to the traditional vocal music education circle. In order to realize the optimization and reform of the vocal music profession, the digital and informationized service technology must be introduced into the vocal music teaching. In modern vocal music class, multimedia technology is the most common auxiliary teaching means, but there is no software suitable for vocal music at present. Therefore, this paper puts forward a set of VisualC++ as the core of the vocal music class development of new ideas. The implementation of the program not only increases the intuitive and interactive vocal music class, but also increases the interest of the class.

articleTitle: Research on Question Severity Detection for Automatic Essay Scoring
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: In the process of essay scoring, the item-specific index is an important factor affecting the final score. In previous studies, the item-specific index was not included in the characteristic system of objective essay scoring. Therefore, it is easy to produce the phenomenon that the deviation from the topic with high language standardization, rich vocabulary and correct grammar is judged high, resulting in the decrease of the accuracy of the score prediction model, which is quite different from the results of manual evaluation. In this paper, the LDA topic model is used to model the article, and the topic probability distribution distance and word vector are used to calculate the topic degree index of the article. The index is added to the composition automatic scoring system to improve the accuracy of the machine scoring.

articleTitle: Studying on Normal Distribution and Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: The original intention of school education is to cultivate talents for the society. The artificial intelligence technology specialty registered in vocational colleges should do a good job in teaching to cultivate application-oriented, skilled and practical talents. Taking the teaching work of offering AI specialized courses in higher vocational colleges as an example, this paper introduces how to use IBM SPSS as a data statistical analysis tool, take students’ grades as data samples, adopt normal distribution and statistical analysis algorithms, and obtain reliable data results after data collection and preprocessing, modeling, analysis, and calculation. Subsequently, as an important basis, the work of curriculum reform was carried out. In the article, the relevant algorithm and operation process are introduced in detail, which may be used as the experience of mutual learning and exchange in the curriculum reform of higher vocational colleges. This is also conducive to the better development and implementation of precision teaching in higher vocational colleges.

articleTitle: Fingerprint Recognition Scheme Based on Deep Learning and Homomorphic Encryption
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: In fingerprint identification, fingerprint features, as a kind of biological feature, are unique, universal, and irrevocable. If it is maliciously attacked, leaked, and tamperedwith, the security of users’ personal fingerprint privacy information will be faced with huge challenges. This paper proposes a fingerprint feature recognition privacy security scheme based on deep learning convolutional neural network and homomorphic encryption algorithm to solve this problem. In this scheme, we add fingerprint classification algorithm to CNN(Convolutional Neural Network) for efficient fingerprint classification and feature extraction. In addition, the BFV homomorphic encryption algorithm is used to encrypt fingerprint feature data and perform matching operations in the ciphertext domain, and fingerprint feature ciphertext database is built to achieve quickly search and matching of feature ciphertext. Finally, we adopt the national secret SM4 and the national secret SM9 algorithms to improve the security of fingerprint signature ciphertext transmission and the ability to resist malicious attacks. The experimental results show that the scheme considers the accuracy of fingerprint identification and overall efficiency and improve the security of fingerprint feature data transmission, storage, and comparison.

articleTitle: Self-selected generation retrieval framework based on topic keyword model
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: This paper presents a self-iterating framework implemented in a retrieval dialogue scenario that captures the one-to-many mapping relationships in multiple rounds of dialogue and retrieves multiple conversational contexts from the dialogue corpus that are both semantically diverse and logically coherent. The training model of the framework also allows for the selection and optimisation of individual models in the framework to automatically expand the dialogue corpus to form a one-to-many dialogue dataset.

articleTitle: 5G Mobile Communication Network Site Planning And Regional Clustering Problems
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: The location and planning of base stations, which are related to the quality of communication services and the construction cost of base stations, are highlights of widespread concern in the field of communication. Based on the analysis of existing base station locations of the 5G mobile communication network, the article adopts the immune genetic algorithm and DBSCAN algorithm to mathematically model and analyze the types and locations of new base stations. The base station locations are reasonably planned to achieve the optimization of cost and coverage conditions. Clustering analysis of different weak coverage areas is done to realize the partition management of different weak coverage areas, which makes it possible to better solve the weak coverage problem.

articleTitle: Gesture recognition based on human - computer interaction
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: The man-machine interaction technology based on gesture recognition has some problems, such as slow speed and low precision of static gesture recognition, and poor expansibility of gesture action. Yolov4-Tiny algorithm based on attention mechanism was proposed, and action semantics was designed by combining basic gestures with gesture state change, and the application function was called according to action semantics, which realize efficient human-computer interaction. By comparing the methods involved in each process, it can be seen that deep learning has strong fault tolerance, robust-ness, high parallelism, anti-interference, etc., which has achieved great achievements above the traditional learning algorithm in the field of gesture identification.

articleTitle: Research Method of Maker Education Based on Regression Models
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: With the rapid development of maker education in China, more and more science and technology enterprises, publishing units, science popularization venues, and educational institutions have been involved in the upsurge of resource development for maker education. Research on the development trend of maker education also shows an upward trend. However, most of the existing studies on trend prediction give the future development trend of maker education in the way of literature statistics and subjective judgment, which makes the prediction results strongly subjective. In order to solve this problem, we drew on the advantages of machine learning in data prediction and proposed a research method for maker education based on regression models. The core idea of the proposed method is to use the characteristics of regression models to predict future maker education without adding subjective factors. Specifically, we built regression models based on the collected historical data, and then predicted future development based on these regression models. In the experiment, we verified the effectiveness of the model based on the research literature on maker education in China from 2013 to 2019.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of English Grammar Error Correction System Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: At present, our English error correction algorithm is slightly general, the error correction ability is also very limited, and its accuracy rate is also low, so it is very necessary to improve. This article will further explore the problem of syntax error correction, and the corresponding algorithm model will also be proposed. Based on deep learning technology to improve the error correction rate of English grammar, put forward the corresponding solution, put forward the Sep2seq-based English grammar error correction system model, and carry out a series of rectifications to improve its efficiency and accuracy. The basic architecture of TensorFLOW is used to implement the model, and the success of the error correction algorithm model is proved, which brings great improvement and progress to the success of error correction.

articleTitle: Application of Data Mining Technology in Ideological and Political Teaching
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: In the era of big data, the application of data mining technology in ideological and political teaching can solve the practical problem of how to extract the implicit and high-value educational information knowledge or model from the fragmented data torrent. Firstly, this paper points out the adaptability of data mining technology and ideological and political teaching by combining functional analysis and demand analysis. Secondly, with the help of embedded system analysis method, the application model based on data mining technology in ideological and political teaching practice is constructed. Finally, the concrete measures to promote the application of data mining technology are put forward.

articleTitle: Mining Sentiment-Dependent Linguistic Patterns from Automotive Reviews for Product Defects
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Due to the universality and rapidity of information dissemination on social media, it is of guiding significance for automobile manufacturers to improve product design and optimize quality management to timely discover the defect information of automobiles from social media. At present, the research on social media defect recognition has mined less defect information and mostly takes negative comments as product defects. To solve this problem, we put forward a comment representation model based on sentiment-dependent linguistic features, which effectively uses the domain context. In reality, the distribution of the data set is biased in some way. To avoid the major defect, we use the clustering-based under-sampling method. The experimental results show that the model can effectively identify car defects in Chinese social media, and has a high accuracy and recall rate.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Library Management Information System Based on SpringMVC
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: At present, most colleges and universities in China have completed the informatization of library management, and the library management has become more scientific and efficient. However, many university library management systems have some problems, such as outdated functions, aging systems and unstable operation. Therefore, the author of this paper designs a college library management information system. Under the Javaweb environment, the whole system is built with SpringMVC framework, MySQL database as the data storage support of the system, Windows 10 as the operating system and Tomcat 8.0 as the web server. With this technology stack, the problem of unstable operation in the previous system has been solved, and a library management information system with higher efficiency and more stable operation has been constructed, which not only reduces the workload of library administrators, but also provides students with a more convenient book borrowing experience and makes the library play the greatest role in campus life..

articleTitle: A Transfer Learning Model based on Residual learning and Maxout For Sketch Works Ranking
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Art education is a special subject in the education system. However, art education still shows a considerable degree of immaturity and imperfection in modern education. For example, a huge gap in the number of art teachers, uneven teaching quality in rural and remote areas, inconsistent standards and extremely cumbersome manual scoring. Intelligently ranking the artworks can effectively alleviate the above problems. In this paper, we expand our dataset SCNU-SW and then give an enhanced transfer learning model to automatically rank sketch works. First, ResNeSt50 is selected as the backbone of transfer learning. Second, data Augmentation, Maxout, Dropout and Relu (AMDR) modules are added in a certain order into ResNeSt50 such that the classification performance and generalization ability of model can be enhanced. Third, we verify the generality of the AMDR module on most convolutional networks in sketch works ranking field. The experimental results on SCNU-SW610 show that our model achieves classification accuracy of 86.6% for ranking sketch works and outperforms the most mainstream models.

articleTitle: Design of interactive multihidden layer neural network for online English teaching
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: In online English teaching, due to the lack of quick understanding of the relevant requirements and resulting in low learning efficiency, so the problem of human-computer interaction in online English teaching is a big problem. The hardware system of the English online interactive teaching platform, the English online learning information collection module, the student learning module, the design of the English online learning interface, adopts the structure based on the multi-hidden neural network, extracts the user information from the data, realizes the intelligent requirements of learning, and gives the corresponding feedback. Through the analysis of the performance and performance of the algorithm, it is proved that the algorithm has good practical value in the storage state and interactivity.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of University Digital Library System Based on Hadoop Framework
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: In order to realize the informatization of university digital library management and establish a real multimedia knowledge center, this paper upgrades and improves the university digital library system. This paper takes big data technology as the core, uses hadoop framework to build a distributed data processing model, and combines Web technology to build a digital library system in colleges and universities in JAVA environment. The system adopts B/S architecture, guided by MVC design idea, and introduces SSM framework to complete the design and deployment of Web Server, which is convenient for users to quickly search and view all kinds of book information and electronic documents through simple interactive operations. It not only meets students’ learning needs, but also provides necessary help for teachers’ teaching and scientific research.

articleTitle: Construction of university internal control Information System Based on Big Data
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: The construction of internal control system is an important measure to improve the governance system of colleges and universities themselves. With the development of social information technology and the requirements of national internal control construction, colleges and universities constantly promote the information construction of internal control system. At present, there are some problems in the internal control system of colleges and universities, such as the disconnection between information system and business system, and the information resources can not be effectively integrated. To this end, this paper uses the “Standard-based Full Business Process Collaborative Management Information System Framework” (XTA) approach, Using J2EE technologyXML technology and other information system integration technology, this paper puts forward the inner-control information construction plan of university from the aspects of construction idea, overall system framework, overall technical route, main construction system, data exchange tool, etc.

articleTitle: Research on Image Processing and Generative Teaching in the Context of AIGC
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: AIGC, meaning AI-generated content, is discussed in this paper, mainly in the form of painting, without discussing the automation of music composition and text-writing poetry, etc. While generative art has aesthetic characteristics, more content needs to be studied in the context of computer information science, with a particular emphasis on computer vision and computer graphics. The article focuses on a comparative analysis of two models, diffusion algorithms and generative adversarial networks, and their application to tools. The practical part of image processing uses a combination of case studies and questionnaires to demonstrate the lack of methodology, teaching experience, and introductory learning materials for non-computer professionals in the emerging field, and to explain “filter mapping” through Processing, a visual programming software. The author’s reflections on the generated content combine the self-similarity of the “Uncanny Valley effect” and the “Dunning Kruger effect” lineage, comparing the “self-organizing” (machine) simulation personification and the “life form” (human) simulation personification. The process of cognitive assimilation of a “living organism” (human) is used to understand the new human-machine associative relationship.

articleTitle: The Role of Race and Gender in the Associations Between Bullying and Screen Time Among Adolescents: Big Data Analyses with Moderation Models Using R
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Researchers have documented that adolescents’ school or electronic bullying victimization took a heavy toll on their mental health, which might give rise to adolescents’ screen time increase like TV watching and video games usage gave the technology growth [11]. However, psychologists have not examined the associations between bullying and screen time with attention to the role of race and gender. The current research examined these associations with the Youth Risk Behavior Survey (YRBS) dataset collected from 1991 to 2019, which is of considerable data points and statistical power. It was assumed that different coping strategies may be adopted by adolescents in different race and ethnicity groups and gender groups such that, the associations between bully victimization and screen time may be moderated by adolescents’ race and gender in different directions. Statistical models conducted by R language was used to examine the proposed hypotheses. The results showed that, generally, there was a direct association between being bullied and an increase in screen time. Furthermore, males used to have more screen time compared to females after being bullied. As shown by simple slope analyses, Black or African Americans remained high in screen time value after bullying victimization compared to other races. The results of the current study were correlational in nature and should be interpreted with caution.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Neural Network-based Approach for Predicting Course Grades
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: For the academic performance prediction problem, a hybrid neural network model (HNNM) is constructed using the advantages of CNN and GRU in processing temporal and spatial data, respectively. Through an online teaching platform, rich data types are collected and the HNNM model is used to study students’ life behavior and classroom learning behavior. Through experiments in several courses, the results show that the HNNM model has high prediction accuracy and can provide more reasonable guidance and suggestions for course teaching improvement and student academic warning.

articleTitle: Research Trend Analysis with SATI on Hybrid-learning in ESL/EFL Since COVID-19
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: In the era of internet+, hybrid learning is bound to become a trend, while the Covid-19 pandemic acts as an accelerator of hybrid learning. This research selected 1773 articles from WOS and opted SATI as the major platform to do the bibliographic information processing. The results of word frequency analysis and co-word analysis were then interpreted to identify the current trend and hotspots of research in the fields of hybrid learning in ESL/EFL. The purpose is to seek more effective teaching mode reform and innovation in the future and make new technology really serve teaching.

articleTitle: Investigation of Common Issues in Biology Teachers’ Qualification Certificate Interviews and Assessment Prediction using Ensemble Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: Evaluating professional competence has been a significant challenge for educators. Professional competence is widely evaluated, and the implications for all those seeking certification are stringent. Through research on some problems with examinees in the biology teacher qualification examination of a middle school in recent years, this paper puts forward some suggestions on the cultivation of biology teacher-students in middle schools. This work proposes an intelligent method for identifying the influential factors in predicting failure on the biology teachers’ qualification certificate exam. This work utilizes ensemble learning method to predict the examinees result. The relationship between the variables and the influential factors are identified by using correlation analysis. The statistical significance of the proposed model is assessed with the help of the proportional chance criterion. The proposed model was statistically significant according to the experimental results.

articleTitle: Research on Learning Resource Recommendation Algorithm Based on User Demand Evolution
publicationTitle: 2022 3rd International Conference on Information Science and Education (ICISE-IE)
abstract: With the continuous development of online education platforms, a vast number of learning resources have brought challenges to users’ choices. It is feasible to introduce the recommendation algorithms in e-commerce directly into the online learning platforms to recommend courses for learners. However, they often ignore the dynamic evolution of learning needs, resulting in partially ineffective recommendations. To solve this problem, we propose a method called LR-DE, which takes the change rule of user needs into account. It first exploits gated recurrent units to extract the users’ learning interest states at each time step. Then, to address the phenomenon of interest incoherence in behavior sequences, we introduce the attention mechanism to upgrade the update gate in GRUs structure and construct a new network structure called AUGRU. At the same time, the bilinear feature interaction is used to calculate the correlation scores between the click histories and the candidates so as to capture the co-occurrence relation between the two courses. Experimental results show that our method is superior to the existing methods in learning resource recommendation tasks and can effectively improve recommendation accuracy.
